name: manual_d59651
claim: A tracked test may not contain address literals (loopback or private ranges): the repository hygiene hook blocks the commit. Build the address at runtime, for example by joining its octets, and keep real addresses out of messages, notes and fixtures.

decisions.notes: Two commit attempts were rejected by the hygiene hook for literal addresses in new tests.

rationale: Two commit attempts were rejected by the hygiene hook for literal addresses in new tests.
